requires: verified DSEC_native_v1 acceptance and fixed canonical6000/valid2152
sufficiently trained fresh-init native baseline with checkpoint and sidecar SHA
source63-file hashes, source BN policy, geometry, precision, checkpoint and dataset hashes
common D_fpBN all-execution reference and separately reported D_fpBN minus P-paper quality
bounded source-sn2 sampling artifact, widths per block and actual PE group width

score_sampling.reference_graph: common D_fpBN, eval with fixed BN, complete branches, no augmentation
score_sampling.tensor: native MS_Spiking_Mlp.sn2 output BEFORE drop2/fc2, TBHWC
score_sampling.timing_and_memory: Measure actual CPU scoring and device-to-host collection; no throughput estimate supplied
score_sampling.optional_expansion: Not automatically enabled; use existing120h envelope and bind a new explicit target list

comparison.tie_break: descending score; original hidden-channel index ascending on ties
comparison.physical_compaction: Pack selected original channels densely; retained width must be exactly PE-group aligned

recovery_proposal.meaning: bounded numerical/learning screen, not a convergence guarantee or failure criterion
recovery_proposal.optimizer: new AdamW; do NOT load unsliced dense optimizer state
recovery_proposal.training_targets: same order from4573 gate-fit members for all arms
recovery_proposal.geometry: crop288x384 window2x9x9; later full9 deployment evaluation
recovery_proposal.precision: FP32, B1, T10; same reset/native loss/augmentation as baseline
recovery_proposal.BN_policy: fixed running statistics during matched initial recovery; affine parameters may train equally in all arms
recovery_proposal.after_model_train: explicitly restore every BN to eval so statistics do not update silently
recovery_proposal.extension: if necessary, equal recovery and search opportunity for SVS/magnitude/dense; fit within existing120GPUh cap

BN_recalibration_after_recovery.pool: fixed auxiliary BN initial176, optionally predeclared expanded703
BN_recalibration_after_recovery.policy: fresh complete graph capture per arm, full9/B1/T10/no augmentation; original calibration helper and pooled moments
BN_recalibration_after_recovery.optional_cal1: same predeclared rule and sample allowance for every arm

final_evaluation.scope: all2152 valid targets and all valid GT; frame-mean AEE plus pixel-weighted/sequence/B/L/U
final_evaluation.required_precision_decomposition: P-paper to D_fpBN; SVS/magnitude change; recovery; recalibration; quantization only if later separately implemented
final_evaluation.hardware: recompute actual hidden-dependent FC and PSN2 services and memory on the same resource engine; parameter reduction alone is not cycle evidence
final_evaluation.claim_limit: No restored AEE, new BN statistics, trained pruning ranking, quantization or cycle improvement has been produced
